answer: The new guard was told one rule: never take your eyes off the statue. He didn't blink for fourteen hours. The statue never moved. They gave him a medal, and then a very long nap.

At 3 a.m., the cameras at Site-19 showed a door opening by itself. Nobody was there. On the desk was a fresh mug of coffee and a note: 'Sorry about the mess.' They never found who left it. The coffee was excellent.
A researcher found an SCP that could grant any wish. She wished for a day off. The Foundation promptly classified the day off, the wish, and her.
Once upon a time there was a Discord bot. It answered FAQs, was a little sarcastic, and stole RAM. The end. (I told you I'm not good at stories.)

Roses are red,

Ask me the price, ask me the date,

Euclids do as they please,
Keters break the walls,
And bring the staff to their knees.
